tools.name: xero_create_quote_smart
tools.short_description: SMART: AI-optimized Xero quote creation with automatic contact lookup and template selection
tools.description: 🤖 SMART TOOL - AI-optimized quote creation with automatic contact lookup, template selection, and intelligent defaults. Use this for natural language quote requests. Handles the complete workflow in one call: finds customer, selects template, creates quote, and returns ready-to-send result.

customer.description: Customer name, email, or contact ID. Smart lookup will find the contact automatically. Examples: 'John Smith', 'john@example.com', 'ABC Company', or exact ContactID GUID. Required.

items.description: Quote items - can be simple strings or detailed objects. Smart parser handles both formats. Required. Examples: ['Business Cards 1000qty', 'Flyers A5 500qty'] or [{'description': '...', 'quantity': 1, 'price': 150}]

template.description: Template/branding to use. Optional - auto-selects appropriate template if not provided. Examples: 'Standard', 'Professional', 'Default', or exact template name

title.description: Quote title. Optional - auto-generates if not provided based on items

valid_days.description: Quote validity in days. Optional - defaults to 30 days. Sets expiry_date automatically

terms.description: Terms and conditions. Optional - uses business defaults if not provided

auto_send.description: Automatically mark as SENT after creation. Optional - defaults to false (DRAFT)

returns.description: Comprehensive result with created quote details, contact info, PDF URL, and smart recommendations

parameters.title: Printing Quote
parameters.notes: Rush order available for additional fee
